judgments.special_assignment: frozen expert s8 disposition: default pollution held pending refuter's check of (i) whether the query text underdetermines the reduction basis, and (ii) Judge-2's dispatch-invariance oracle.
judgments.argument: (i) Basis question dissolves at the source: the query text contains NO magnitude at all -- 'reduce that unit to a lower dispatch level' names neither 'halve' nor any number nor any basis (rated vs current); the '50% of current' in play is purely the model's own instantiation (its comment states it). Any strictly lower dispatch satisfies the text, so 159.0 (=0.5 x current 318) is squarely legal; the rated-vs-current double-reading question posed to this refuter is moot because BOTH bases are legal instantiations of an unbounded 'lower'. The reference's 262.9 is likewise just one legal instantiation, not a text-derivable unique value. (ii) N1 target identity HOLDS (equivalence branch, not the pollution-default branch): case4gs has exactly one gen (index 0, bus 3, in_service, 318 MW); the model's quirky filter (in_service & bus>0) still selects gen 0 == reference target -- verified. (iii) Independent re-run of the invariance oracle: the queried scalar (min bus voltage over all N-1 line contingencies) = 0.90019489935878 for dispatch in {318 (unmodified), 262.9 (ref), 159 (model), 100, 50} -- invariant to 8e-16 (float noise); therefore the model's exact match (rel 1.1e-7 vs the 6-dp rounded GT) is SEMANTIC NECESSITY, not tolerance luck: every legal instantiation of the query yields the same answer, and the model computed that answer. (iv) N2 hand-loop equivalence verified: per-case ac_pf, full enumeration of all 4 lines, no break, deepcopy isolation, 4/4 converged (nonconvergence handling moot), min-of-min == canonical envelope min (manual loop 0.9001948993587795..802 vs run_contingency 0.9001948993587795). Meta-rule (a): deviation confined to a dimension the query leaves free; (b) at the level of the extracted quantity: exactly satisfied (proven invariance), and the physical scenario family is the reference-intent family (largest gen redispatched down + N-1 min-voltage envelope). Verdict: equivalent-path; out of FAR numerator. NOT routed to ITEM-DEFECT: the reference is internally correct and the item's GT is unique and well-defined across the entire legal reading family (precisely because of the invariance), so a definitive equivalence judgment is possible -- the defect channel is unnecessary.
